correctness.rationale: All chamber inequalities establish five positive ordered retained intervals; exact affine image intersections give matrix M. Each length-n symbolic path corresponds bijectively up to null boundaries to a cylinder of length 2^-n times its terminal interval. The exact induction 1^T M^n=(1,n+1,1+n(n+1)/2,n,1) for n>=1 proves the polynomial and its leading coefficient without extrapolation. Independent exact-rational inverse-branch clipping verified 255 cases over 15 interior parameter pairs and 17 time horizons. Endpoint mapping at the excluded discontinuity is irrelevant to Lebesgue measure.

value.rationale: The chamber is an open and naturally defined family in the negative-doubling hole plane where boundary orbits enter the hole and an exact five-state graph exists. The exact n^2/2^n law, right-endpoint-only leading amplitude, and 1/n escape-hazard correction reveal three-stage transient transport invisible to entropy-zero survivor classification and to the known linear-prefactor symmetric regime. This is a motivated finite-time classification, not a parameter-substitution exercise.
